title: 路演算力提49次：安全仅27次，**人为何说完全兼容？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: I already want to go to what happens next, you know, with Anthropic, it's that tension between doing what's right for safety alignment.
segments.zh: 我已经想谈谈接下来会发生什么，你知道，对于Anthropic来说，就是在安全对齐方面做正确的事之间的那种张力。

segments.en: They talk about that a lot, and what's now in the interest of public market shareholders, but you've been along for the ride, so your assessment of how they will balance that.
segments.zh: 他们经常谈论这一点，以及现在符合公开市场股东利益的是什么，但你一直参与其中，所以你对他们会如何平衡这一点的评估。

segments.en: I would argue that there isn't a tension between...
segments.zh: 我认为两者之间并不存在张力……

segments.en: So, the Krishna Ralph? Over the long term, for a business to maximise its revenue and profit, often it has to pursue that through a liquidity.
segments.zh: 所以，Krishna Ralph？从长远来看，企业要实现收入和利润最大化，往往必须通过流动性来追求。

segments.en: It has to pursue things that maybe aren't so obvious, and I think safety is the thing for Anthropic here.
segments.zh: 它必须追求一些可能不那么明显的东西，我认为安全对Anthropic来说就是这样的东西。

segments.en: By pursuing safe AI, I think that is completely compatible with maximising long-term shareholder value.
segments.zh: 通过追求安全的人工智能，我认为这与最大化长期股东价值是完全兼容的。

segments.en: I saw something that you'd said in recent days, and maybe it's in the rearview mirror now, but we'd anthropic look back at the market volatility of latent headlines and say,
segments.zh: 我看到你最近几天说过一些话，也许现在已经是过去式了，但Anthropic会回顾市场波动和潜在头条新闻说，

segments.en: oh, why are we going public in this environment? So far, it has been incredibly smooth, and the management team's conviction quite justified.
segments.zh: 哦，为什么我们要在这种环境下上市？到目前为止，一切非常顺利，管理团队的信念非常合理。

segments.en: I think they've executed the process well. I'm also highly confident that when we look back in five or ten years' time, whether Anthropic has been successful or not,
segments.zh: 我认为他们很好地执行了这个过程。我也高度确信，当我们回顾五年或十年后，无论Anthropic是否成功，

segments.en: it will not be because of what the market environment was on the week in which they went public.
segments.zh: 都不会是因为他们上市那一周的市场环境如何。

segments.en: It will be to do with whether or not they can continue to push the frontier, convince customers to use their models and grow their computers.
segments.zh: 关键在于他们能否持续推动前沿、说服客户使用其模型并扩大算力。

segments.en: I think we are getting close now as a reminder, Anthropic is indicated to open at $111 a share, having priced its IP of $83 a share, and that indicated opening is trickled up.
segments.zh: 提醒一下，我们已接近开盘，Anthropic 指示性开盘价为每股111美元，发行价为每股83美元，该指示性开盘价已逐步走高。
